title: The hybrid decides per author: push for most, no fan-out for the very big
caption: One threshold on follower count. A huge threshold is pure push; a threshold of 0 is pure pull.

steps.text: A post arrives. Look up the author's follower count (kept as a counter, not counted live).
Above the threshold (say 100 000): write the post once and keep it in a hot, replicated cache. Readers merge it in when they open the feed.
Below it: fan out, but skip followers who haven't opened the app in 30 days. Their timeline is rebuilt with pull if they return.
Push the post id into the remaining followers' timelines, asynchronously.
